steps.title: Know your models
steps.html:
Type each gray word in the Filter models box.

@MODELS@

This list is also on the Canvas tab in VR.

steps.title: Go on location
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Playground in Filter environments. Click Playground, then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Build the scene
steps.html:
Press the top button on your right controller, then click Models. Put the Alligator, Snake, Butterfly and Darner on the ground. Then add the Ice Berg.

✋ Grab a model with the palm trigger. Use both palm triggers to make it bigger or smaller.
🗣 Say it out loud: “The ___ fits here because ___. The ice berg does not fit because ___.”

steps.title: Take the shot and send it
steps.html:
Stand back so the whole scene fits. Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Click Take photo.

Click the Canvas tab and pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 Want to fix it? Move the models, take a new photo and send it again.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your photo is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? Open Having trouble in VR?

extra.html: Add a plant that holds rain water for frogs: Bromeliad Plant

vr.full: Your photo shows the Alligator, Snake, Butterfly and Darner, plus the Ice Berg that does not fit.

studio.title: Wet or dry?

labels.start: It is the wet season. Water covers the marsh. Flip the switch to the dry season.
labels.flipped: The dry season! The water shrank to one gator hole. Where does each animal go?
labels.peek: This is the wet season. Flip back to the dry season to keep going.
labels.q: Where does the {from} go in the dry season?
labels.done: Every animal found its place in the dry season. Nice work, crew!
cols: Where it goes in the dry season

studio.look: Two drawn models of the same Everglades marsh. In the wet season, rain covers the marsh with water. In the dry season, the water shrinks to a gator hole. A gator hole is a pond an alligator digs and keeps open.
studio.do: Flip the switch to the dry season. Then drag each animal onto the place it goes, or tap the place. Then pick why.

frames.lead: 1. How does the dry season change the marsh?
frames.starter: In the dry season, the water ___, so ___.

frames.lead: 2. Why do some animals fit the Everglades?

studio.full: You flipped the season, placed all 4 animals and picked why. Your 2 sentences have at least 20 words.

wet.alt: Drawing of a marsh covered with water, grass poking up, and an island of trees

dry.alt: Drawing of the same marsh in the dry season: cracked mud, one small pond and the island of trees

animals.name: Alligator
animals.alt: Close look at an alligator's face and teeth in the grass
animals.ok: Yes! The alligator stays in its gator hole and keeps it open and wet.
animals.miss: Think about who dug the pond. Try again.

animals.name: Mosquitofish
animals.alt: A tiny gray fish lying in a person's hand
animals.ok: Yes! Small fish crowd into the last water.
animals.miss: A fish needs water to live. Where is the water now?

animals.name: Wood stork
animals.alt: A wood stork, a big white bird with a bare gray head
animals.ok: Yes! Wood storks come to catch the crowded fish.
animals.miss: This bird eats fish. Where are the fish now?

animals.name: Apple snail
animals.alt: The round brown shell of a Florida apple snail
animals.ok: Yes! Apple snails dig into the mud and wait for the rain to come back.
animals.miss: The snail has a trick. It hides and waits for rain. Where could it dig?

studio.allPlaced: Three animals went to the gator hole, and the snail dug into the mud.

options.water: 💧 It holds the last water, so many animals can live.

claim.miss: Look where the fish and the stork went. What did they need?

voice.brief: Welcome back to the forest, crew. We film Scene 29, Who Fits Here? Show me who belongs in the Everglades, and who does not.
voice.step1: Before your headset goes on, meet your five models. Learn each gray search word. You will type it in VR.
voice.step2: Put on your headset. Click Explore, type Tranquil, and pick Tranquil Forest MEGA. Then click Begin Solo.
voice.step3: Put the alligator, the snake, the butterfly and the dragonfly on the ground. Add the ice berg. Then tell me what does not fit.
voice.extra: Got time? Add a plant that holds rain water for frogs. That shot is just for VR crews.
voice.step4: Step back so the whole scene fits. Click Library, then Camera, and take the shot. Then send it to Canvas.
voice.step5: Press the Meta button and click Quit. Then open Canvas. Your photo should be waiting there.
voice.studio: No headset today? Come to the studio. Turn the wet season into the dry season. Then help each animal find water.
